$comment: feat-018 BR-RT-8: (html, count) pairs, counted in Unicode code points by server and client: one LF between consecutive leaf blocks (paragraph, heading, code block), one per br, none before the first or after the last; a lone surrogate is replaced by U+FFFD and counts 1. Run by both suites.

cases.note: A list item is a container and adds no separator of its own.
Two UTF-16 units, one code point.
Three emoji and two joiners: each code point counts.
An empty paragraph is a leaf block of zero length.
The line feed inside a code block is a character.

A lone high surrogate between two letters is replaced by U+FFFD and counts 1; the stored html holds U+FFFD. {U+D83D} stands for the UTF-16 code unit itself (a lone surrogate is not valid in every JSON reader): substitute it before use.
U+00A0 counts 1 (written as an entity, never counted as six).
